scope: Read-only bounded blind point-position/color/intensity proposals under fixed current native transport and encoding, with fixed retained/material/sky sources and withheld atlas-block qualification; no automatic entity export, bake calibration, spotlights or original-author metadata claim
fixture_provenance: First-party native compiled rooms with off-grid lights, overlapping colors, opaque geometry, native styles/encoding, generated textures and material emitters. Original lights are stripped and MAP/SRF poisoned before inference. Hidden source positions are used only as evaluation labels, never candidate input. Successful proposals are added to independently decompiled MAPs and fully recompiled/baked.

broad_suite_before_help_and_material_con.failure_explanation: A repeated fixture run retained a valid implicit fallback texture, invalidating the original missing-image assumption. The control now explicitly requests a missing q3map_lightimage. The corrected full point matrix and focused missing-image/fallback control pass on the final Windows binary.

cross_platform_point_reports.difference_explanation: Two gamma cases differ only in initial-alternative continuous objective floats; the missing-material case uses the earlier image-path fixture on Linux/sanitizer and the final explicit missing-lightimage fixture on Windows.
cross_platform_point_reports.qualification: Input identities and material filenames are excluded. Each platform independently passes positional, native-byte, rebuild and withheld controls; exact floating point/search-path equality is not a portable promise. The main Linux/sanitizer matrices precede the explicit missing-lightimage fixture correction, which has its own final control.

normal_bake_reference_parity.runs: Prior compiler/1 worker, current/1 worker, current/4 workers, current/4 workers without sample culling
normal_bake_reference_parity.additional_checks: Material alpha/filter mutations, disabled shadows, dense grid and current 1/4/20/70-worker parity

corrections_to_prior_evidence: In docs/validation/light-comparison.json the sRGB-labelled closed-room cases supplied both -nosRGB and -sRGBlight; the native fixed-order option parser applied -nosRGB last. Those runs were linear and do not qualify sRGB. The corrected 67-report matrix uses unambiguous per-channel options and asserts the effective lightmaps_srgb field.

The shared plain-room fixture selected shaders/ for Qfusion, whose actual profile uses scripts/. Its earlier room probes/comparisons used fallback material images. The fixture now loads the intended generated material; native probe tests assert shader text and nondefault images.

The initial missing-material control replaced editor/stage image paths. A retained valid implicit texture on a repeat run could legitimately satisfy compiler fallback, so that did not establish a missing requested light image. The final control explicitly supplies an unavailable q3map_lightimage, verifies its rejection even with a valid fallback, and checks both implicit-material policies.
limits: The full suites precede the help-text correction. The Windows full run passed 75 groups and exposed the repeat-run material fixture issue; its corrected complete point matrix and CLI help pass on the final binary. Linux passes 75/76 with area_factors skipped. The final explicit missing-lightimage/fallback control and light-stage help are checked on every final binary.

Linux ASan/UBSan covers twelve selected groups; lifetime-leak detection remains disabled. The main Linux/sanitizer matrices use the initial missing-material control, supplemented by the final explicit missing-lightimage control.

Point fitting keeps current entity/material/sky sources fixed and uses an explicit encoding hypothesis. Original bake settings, complete asset identities, indirect light, normal/nudge reconstruction and adaptive subsampling remain unknown or unmodelled.

Withheld blocks are within one atlas/BSP, not independent scenes or calibrated probability estimates. A low residual cannot establish a unique arrangement or distinguish missing direct lights from every omitted effect.
Only the nonnegative inverse-square point family is searched. Custom linear/dark/jittered lights, spotlight/target inference, encoding calibration, entity export and GUI review remain open.
Coarse grids, bounded local search, greedy source counts, intensity ceilings and finite budgets can miss better solutions. Exact GPU acceleration and performance claims are outside this round.
Fitting excludes observed 255 channels and unknown baseline/encoding cases; values below 255 still do not prove invertibility. Shared geometry/atlas observations are correlated.
Dedicated trace-node exhaustion, every resource ceiling, larger real-map corpora and general author-light accuracy remain unqualified.
No editor/game renderer, screen capture or user-input control was used. Portable archives were not refreshed and no new external code was incorporated.

Older policy-blocked cleanup targets were not retried. Previously documented parser-sign/include-line findings, compiler warnings, VIS discrepancies, sidecar publication and intermittent Windows process delays remain outside this round.
M11 Radiant patch RGB/alpha painting and per-surface density/preview, intelligent compiler optimization and the broader recovery goal remain open.
